verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a SaaS research and notebook product, since it could ship an API or CLI. The evidence pack documents only interactive UI features: uploads, chat, Audio and Video Overviews, exports and sharing. Nothing shows an API, CLI or headless mode, and deferring generations when out of AI limits is an adjacent feature, not automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
